candidates.statement: Gateway checkout returns 502 after ~2s because its call to order times out (transport ReadTimeout), and order's own call to payment also times out at ~2s; the payment leg is the slow downstream hop propagating latency up to checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side server telemetry absent; cannot confirm payment is the origin versus order-side timeout handling.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s at ~2s align with transport ReadTimeouts on gateway->order and order->payment spans; inventory/redis succeed fast. Payment is the deepest slow hop, but payment-side telemetry is missing, so the bounded candidate is downstream latency with residual uncertainty.
missing_evidence: Payment service traces/logs/metrics for /v1/authorizations to confirm server-side latency origin
Order service server-side telemetry to distinguish its own slowness from payment dependency
Dependency operation metrics for gateway/order (empty series) to quantify timeout source
